state_hierarchy.rule: Transition states are executor observations, never planner decisions.

state_safety.commit_rule: Completion flags commit only after objective evidence and SUCCESS_HOME.
state_safety.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN never becomes SUCCESS and never commits state.

migration_priority.reason: Existing bounded execution and HOME verification provide the strongest reusable path.
Existing skill mechanics need a normalized HOME return.
Entry, target, battle, result, and cleanup remain distributed across multiple paths.

implementation_roadmap.name: Architecture freeze
implementation_roadmap.goal: Approve boundaries and keep candidate knowledge non-executable.

implementation_roadmap.name: Planner replacement
implementation_roadmap.goal: Use one HOME-only deterministic planner after unknowns are resolved.

implementation_roadmap.name: Room normalization
implementation_roadmap.goal: Normalize REST, VOCAL, SKILL, and AUDITION to the common lifecycle.

implementation_roadmap.name: Remove duplicated paths
implementation_roadmap.goal: Retire duplicate orchestration only after verified parity.
